text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Open campus preparations again 
today, right? Let's get started once Sweep 
gets here!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm... What's up, Cesario? You've got kind 
of a gloomy look on your face...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...It is about the other day. When I was 
preparing together with Sweep-san—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san. That luggage is far too large 
for you. Allow me to carry it instead.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmph...! This much is nothing! I'm going 
to see it through to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Let us divide the roles according to our 
suitability. Heavy items for me, and light 
ones for you—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut uuuuup! Jeez, just 
leave me alone!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It was my blunder. Prioritizing 
efficiency, I voiced my opinion... Without 
considering Sweep-san's feelings, I acted 
entirely selfishly.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. ...In that case, how about 
this?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My brother and sister are coming over to 
hang out this weekend. You should join us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Over the weekend, as I headed into town, I 
spotted Vodka and Cesario. They had two 
small children with them.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're from Tracen Academy! Heheh, 
we're goin' hiking with these guys. The 
little runts are my younger brother and 
sister!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Brother
text_block_list.text:
Who're you callin' a runt! Stop treatin' 
us like babies all the time, sis!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis's friend is with us too~! She's 
gonna play with us lots and lots.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mountain climbing with curious, energetic 
children must be tough. With more people, 
we can keep a closer eye on them. Maybe I 
should tag along as well.
choice_data_list: Mind if I join in too, if it's okay?
Mind if I join in too, if it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Brother
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, let's race! Jump across those 
rocks over there, and see who reaches the 
other side first! It's a match!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Across those rocks by the water...? That 
might be dangerous. They are wet from the 
water, so they will be slippery, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Sister
text_block_list.text:
It's fiiiine! We go exploring all the 
time~! This is nothin' for us!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, then I'll take you on! Don't 
go crying when you lose, got it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Brother
text_block_list.text:
Haah! I'm in the lead! Sis, you've been 
behind us this whole time! You're not all 
that great after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Talk all you want! Overtaking everyone at 
the very end in one go is what's coolest, 
ya know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Brother
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Then I'm just gonna run straight to 
the finish—

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Brother
text_block_list.text: Eh— Woah, whoa! My foot slipped...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hup. ...Heheh, good thing I was right 
behind you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka caught her brother. She had been 
keeping watch from the perfect position so 
she could support him whenever he might 
stumble.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There, watch your step. ...So, what're you 
gonna do? Still wanna race?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Brother
text_block_list.text: ...~~! N-No, I'll pass...! Thanks, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Vodka-san. I feel I understand the 
reason you brought me along now.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Conveying guidance while respecting the 
other party's feelings... You have shown 
me an excellent example.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to be an example or 
anything. I'm just always like this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I used to be a little 
troublemaker too. So I get how those kids 
feel.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're being selfish, having an 
adult who straightforwardly accepts your 
feelings makes you happy, right?
choice_data_list:
You might actually be cut out to be an 
instructor.

You really are a great big sister to your 
brother and sister.

You really are a great big sister to your 
brother and sister.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haaah?! No way, no way, that's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, do you think so? I agree with the 
Trainer's opinion as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I saw the horse girls 
carrying supplies. Cesario kept one hand 
free, walking alongside Sweep Tosho so she 
could support her at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh~~...! You're pretty understanding 
after all...! This much is nothing to 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. Never giving up until the 
very end... that is what makes you who you 
are, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, maybe so. Those guys are quite a 
handful, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I'm totally fine without Big Sis 
anyway! I can even go shopping all by 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, is that so? Well then, from now on 
you can go to the bathroom in the middle 
of the night by yourself too, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! ...H-Hmph, I can totally go! But if 
Big Sis really wants to come along, I 
won't stop you or anything.
